entries.headline: XPeng unveils IRON humanoid and Turing VLA 3.0 physical AI architecture at AI Day, targeting mass production in January 2027
entries.summary: XPeng showed its IRON humanoid with about 1,500 tactile sensors alongside its Turing physical AI stack, and said it may be priced near an EV. Reports say mass production starts January 2027, with store-assistant trials in Q1 2027 and sales around Q2 2027; some sources say no price was named.
evidence: covered by Bloomberg, Xinhua, Nikkei, Seeking Alpha and dozens more

entries.headline: California DMV bars Waymo from freeways after safety incidents
entries.summary: Waymo halted freeway rides after the California DMV ordered a ban, citing safety incidents.

entries.headline: Nvidia forecasts more than $25 billion in physical AI revenue in fiscal 2027
entries.summary: Nvidia expects physical AI revenue to exceed $25 billion in fiscal 2027, roughly quadrupling.

entries.headline: Genesis AI announces $500M Series A at $3.5B valuation
entries.summary: Genesis AI raised a $500M Series A.

entries.headline: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia president, CEO and board member; Vance says he was not under investigation
entries.summary: Robotics247 reports Huang was reinstated as CEO and board member, while another item says he resigned amid a scandal. Reuters reports Vance said Huang was not under investigation before his return.

entries.headline: Volvo Cars trains Hexagon AEON humanoids for Ghent factory work from 2027
entries.summary: Volvo is training Hexagon Robotics humanoids for production at its Belgium plant, starting mid-2027.

entries.headline: EU delays vote on Tesla's assisted self-driving system to December 15
entries.summary: EU postponed the discussion on approving Tesla FSD; Tesla shares slipped about 1.2%.

entries.headline: Waymo recall covers 4,488 vehicles tied to closed-lane and highway incidents
entries.summary: Reports describe a Waymo recall of 4,488 ADS units linked to 11 closed-lane incidents and two highway issues.

entries.headline: Rockwell Automation to acquire AGILOX
entries.summary: Rockwell will acquire mobile robot maker AGILOX.

entries.headline: Pentagon confirms preliminary talks with GM and Ford on drone component production
entries.summary: The Pentagon is in early talks with automakers on drone components.

entries.headline: Boston Dynamics expands GlobalFoundries partnership with Spot and Atlas
entries.summary: Spot and Atlas will be used in semiconductor facilities.

entries.headline: Robotera deploys 45 M7 humanoids at China Post's Hangzhou hub
entries.summary: Robotera put 45 humanoids into fleet operations at China Post.

entries.headline: Tesla's Texas robotaxi registrations pass Waymo's as Cybercabs are added
entries.summary: Reported 1,507 Tesla vehicles registered versus 1,390 for Waymo in Texas, with over 1,000 Cybercabs on the roster.

entries.headline: The Verge examines why Waymo stumbles on freeways after conquering city streets
entries.summary: Analysis of Waymo's freeway problems after millions of urban miles.

entries.headline: US government investigates Waymo over robotaxis passing school buses
entries.summary: A federal investigation concerns Waymo robotaxis passing school buses.

entries.headline: Japan receives first batch of AI interceptor drones built with Ukrainian technology
entries.summary: Japan took delivery of AI-guided interceptor drones.

entries.headline: San Francisco Waymo passenger finds loaded handgun on seat; Waymo reviews customer service
entries.summary: A rider found a loaded gun in a Waymo and said support implied it was his. Waymo says it is reviewing customer service.

entries.headline: GM targets 20% increase in robotics and factory automation by 2028
entries.summary: GM plans more factory automation.

entries.headline: Humyn Labs raises $47M Series A for physical AI
entries.summary: Physical AI research and deployment company Humyn Labs raised $47M.

entries.headline: Wang Xingxing says China robot output will overtake cars; Unitree warns of profit slip; robotics stocks surge
entries.summary: Unitree founder predicts robot output surpassing cars; Chinese and Korean robotics stocks rally.

entries.headline: OpenAI tops Google and Anthropic in humanoid simulation benchmark
entries.summary: Artificial Analysis testing found LLMs struggling at humanoid control, with OpenAI ahead.

entries.headline: Lute raises about $20M to give robots a sense of touch
entries.summary: Polish-American startup Lute raised €17.2M ($20M) for tactile robot sensing.

entries.headline: Samsung roadmap puts unmanned robots in its chip fabs by 2028
entries.summary: Samsung formed a robot team to automate fab work.

entries.headline: India's Bhargavastra counter-swarm drone system clears Pokhran trials
entries.summary: Indigenous counter-drone system completed final trials.

entries.headline: Figure AI answers Musk's staged-demo criticism with apple video
entries.summary: Figure posted a short demo and apology after Musk criticized its demo.
